name: RUN!
source:
You're a forest ranger. You're on your way back to home after a very long shift at night. You stop by the café near the mountain to buy a cup of hot coffee and a slice of sweet pastry. But the barista is so rude, the coffee tastes like sands, and the pastry is too cold and awful. When you think your night is ruined thoroughly, you drop your car key in the dark parking lot, and you can't find it anywhere.

Suddenly waves of people in great panics start running toward you, leaving you only one thing to do: RUN!

[From [url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/run]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名护林员，结束漫长的夜班后正开车回家。你在山脚附近的咖啡馆停下，想买杯热咖啡和一块甜点。可咖啡师态度恶劣，咖啡喝起来像沙子，甜点又冷又难吃。你以为这个夜晚已经糟透了，却在昏暗的停车场里弄丢车钥匙，怎么也找不到。

突然，一大群惊慌失措的人朝你奔来，你只剩一件事可做：快跑！
